summary:
Comprehensive architectural and UI implementation plan for the Underground Face Mapping Strip Log workspace:
1. Full surface lithology fills matching 2D canvas patterns and colors, with interactive lithology and dip surface editing.
2. Clean selective joint editing: hiding handles on unselected joints, displaying start and end points only on selection, adding bend points on demand.
3. Interactive 'Join Traces' workflow to connect multiple cross-surface joint segments into a single unified joint.
4. In-place joint text and parameter editing with floating inspector controls.
